module.purpose: Defines the schema, validator, migrations, defaults, and record type for transient page-specific interaction state scoped to a browser session.
module.summary: This module models per-page interaction state such as selections, hover, editing, cropping, hinting, erasing, focused groups, and metadata. It provides runtime validation, versioned migrations for evolving persisted records, session scoping, ephemeral-field behavior, and default values for newly created records.
module.businessContext: Supports interactive page editing in a browser-based collaborative drawing application. Failure can invalidate page-session state, break editing interactions, or prevent older documents from loading correctly.
functions: up (~L116-118): Adds the cropping state field during record migration
up (~L122-125): Removes obsolete instance and camera fields
up (~L129-131): Adds an empty metadata object to migrated records
up (~L137-139): Performs the intentionally preserved no-op migration
down (~L140-142): Performs the intentionally preserved reverse no-op migration
up (~L146-161): Renames legacy interaction state properties to current names
down (~L162-177): Renames current interaction state properties to legacy names
anonymous default factory (~L224-233): Supplies default values for new page-state records
systemCapabilities: Control undo persistence for transient fields

mutationOfArg: Migrations add, rename, and delete properties directly on migration record arguments.

	createRecordMigrationSequence,

import { TLShapeId } from './TLShape'

detail.name: up
detail.summary: Provides the upward migration step for the first page-state migration sequence entry.

detail.name: up
preconditions: instance is a writable object reference.
invariants: The migration does not alter properties other than croppingShapeId.
edgeCases: If instance already has a croppingShapeId value, it is overwritten with null.
detail.summary: Migrates a page state instance by clearing its cropping shape reference. The instance's croppingShapeId is set to null.

specTests.when: The migration is applied to the instance.
specTests.then: croppingShapeId is null after the call.

detail.name: up
preconditions: The input is a mutable object whose instanceId and cameraId properties may be present.
postconditions: The instanceId property is absent from the input object.
The cameraId property is absent from the input object.
The input object is mutated in place.
invariants: Properties other than instanceId and cameraId are not modified by this function.
edgeCases: If instanceId or cameraId is already absent, deletion remains successful and the function does not add the property.
If both properties are absent, the object remains otherwise unchanged.
If either property is present, it is removed from the same object rather than from a returned copy.
detail.summary: Migrates an instance page-state object by removing the legacy instanceId and cameraId properties.

specLiterals.role: Legacy property name removed during migration.
Legacy property name removed during migration.

specTests.when: The migration's up function is called with that object.
specTests.then: instanceId and cameraId are absent afterward, the other property is preserved, and the original object has been mutated.

detail.name: up
detail.summary: Applies the upward transformation for migration sequence step 3 of instance page state records.

units.name: down

detail.name: down
postconditions: The reverse migration produces no effective change to the page-state data.
invariants: No migration properties are renamed or otherwise transformed.
edgeCases: Any input shape receives the same no-op treatment because this migration does not perform an effective operation.
detail.summary: Represents the reverse migration for the RenameProperties page-state version. As implemented, it performs no effective migration.

units.name: up

detail.name: up
preconditions: record must be a non-null object that can be assigned to and have properties deleted.
postconditions: record.selectedShapeIds contains the prior value of record.selectedIds, and selectedIds is deleted.
record.hintingShapeIds contains the prior value of record.hintingIds, and hintingIds is deleted.
record.erasingShapeIds contains the prior value of record.erasingIds, and erasingIds is deleted.
record.hoveredShapeId contains the prior value of record.hoveredId, and hoveredId is deleted.
record.editingShapeId contains the prior value of record.editingId, and editingId is deleted.
invariants: The migration mutates the supplied record rather than returning a replacement record.
Each legacy property is deleted after its value is copied to the corresponding current property.
edgeCases: If a legacy property is absent, its current property is assigned undefined and the legacy property remains absent after deletion.
If the same record already has current and legacy properties, the current property is overwritten with the legacy value before the legacy property is deleted.
If record is null or undefined, property access throws a runtime TypeError.
If record is not a mutable object, assignment or deletion follows normal JavaScript runtime behavior and may throw.

raises: JavaScript TypeError when record is null or undefined, or when an attempted mutation is invalid for the supplied value.
errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed; JavaScript property access, assignment, and deletion semantics apply.

stateMutations: Mutates the supplied record by assigning selectedShapeIds, hintingShapeIds, erasingShapeIds, hoveredShapeId, and editingShapeId.
Deletes selectedIds, hintingIds, erasingIds, hoveredId, and editingId from the supplied record.
detail.summary: Migrates page-state records by renaming legacy selection, hinting, erasing, hovered, and editing identifier properties to their current names in place.

specTests.when: The migration is applied to the record.
specTests.then: The record has selectedShapeIds = ["shape:1"], hintingShapeIds = ["shape:2"], erasingShapeIds = ["shape:3"], hoveredShapeId = "shape:4", and editingShapeId = "shape:5"; all five legacy properties are absent.

specTests.when: The migration is applied to the record.
specTests.then: The five current properties are assigned undefined and the legacy properties remain absent.

detail.name: down
preconditions: record is a mutable object representing page state.
The source fields may be absent or present; assignments preserve their current values, including undefined.
postconditions: selectedIds contains the prior value of selectedShapeIds, then selectedShapeIds is removed.
hintingIds contains the prior value of hintingShapeIds, then hintingShapeIds is removed.
erasingIds contains the prior value of erasingShapeIds, then erasingShapeIds is removed.
hoveredId contains the prior value of hoveredShapeId, then hoveredShapeId is removed.

invariants: The supplied record object is mutated in place rather than replaced.
Each migrated value is copied directly without transformation.
edgeCases: When a source field is undefined or absent, the corresponding legacy field is assigned undefined before the source field is deleted.
Existing legacy fields are overwritten by the corresponding newer field values.

errorPolicy.onInvalidInput: No explicit validation or fallback is performed; non-object inputs may fail when property mutation is attempted.

detail.summary: Mutates a page-state record in place to migrate renamed shape-state identifiers back to their prior field names.

specTests.when: The migration is applied to the record.
specTests.then: The corresponding selectedIds, hintingIds, erasingIds, hoveredId, and editingId fields contain those values, and the first four newer source fields are absent.
Each corresponding legacy field is assigned undefined and each processed newer source field is absent.

detail.name: defaultProperties
postconditions: Returns an object assignable to Omit<TLInstancePageState, 'id' | 'typeName' | 'pageId'>.
invariants: The returned default properties do not include id, typeName, or pageId.
The selectedShapeIds collection is initialized independently for each returned object.
edgeCases: Called with no arguments: returns the default page-state properties.
Called repeatedly: each result has an empty selectedShapeIds array suitable for independent mutation.
detail.summary: Creates the default page-state properties while excluding the record identity fields. New page-state instances start with no active editing or cropping shape and no selected shapes.

specTests.then: The result has editingShapeId set to null, croppingShapeId set to null, and selectedShapeIds set to an empty array.

specTests.then: The selectedShapeIds array of the second result remains empty.
